assessment.security_status_cs: Japonsko se vyrovnává s následky tajfunu Dujuan, který si vyžádal několik obětí a způsobil materiální škody v oblasti Tokia. Na politické scéně proběhla první jednání premiérky s ukrajinským prezidentem bez formálních závazků k obranné spolupráci, zatímco globální obavy z vývoje AI posílily japonský jen jako bezpečné útočiště.
assessment.security_status_en: Japan is dealing with the aftermath of Typhoon Dujuan, which claimed several lives and caused material damage around Tokyo. Politically, the leadership held initial talks with the Ukrainian president without formal commitments to defense cooperation, while global AI sector jitters strengthened the Japanese yen as a safe haven.

recommendations.reason_cs: Trh reaguje na globální technologické výkyvy a posilující jen, což vytváří smíšený sentiment pro exportéry.
recommendations.reason_en: The market is reacting to global tech fluctuations and a strengthening yen, creating mixed sentiment for exporters.

recommendations.reason_cs: Posilující jen snižuje marže ze zahraničního prodeje, avšak domácí poptávka zůstává stabilní.
recommendations.reason_en: The strengthening yen squeezes foreign sales margins, though domestic demand remains stable.

recommendations.reason_cs: Globální tlaky v technologickém sektoru vyvolané obavami z vývoje umělé inteligence doléhají na ocenění firem.
recommendations.reason_en: Global tech sector pressures driven by AI development concerns are weighing on valuations.

recommendations.reason_cs: Poptávka po technologických řešeních v oblasti infrastruktury a varovných systémů (včetně mezinárodní spolupráce) podporuje růst.
recommendations.reason_en: Demand for technological solutions in infrastructure and warning systems (including international cooperation) supports growth.

recommendations.sector_cs: Pražská burza: ČEZ, Komerční banka, Erste Group
recommendations.sector_en: Prague Stock Exchange: ČEZ, Komerční banka, Erste Group
recommendations.reason_cs: Události v Japonsku mají na české blue chips jen minimální a zanedbatelný nepřímý vliv.
recommendations.reason_en: Developments in Japan have a minimal and negligible indirect impact on Czech blue chips.

assessment.forecast_cs: Očekává se stabilizace po průchodu tajfunu a postupné obnovení dopravní i ekonomické infrastruktury v zasažených regionech. Kurz jenu bude nadále citlivě reagovat na globální sentiment vůči rizikovým aktivům.
assessment.forecast_en: Stabilization is expected following the typhoon's passage, along with the gradual restoration of transport and economic infrastructure in affected regions. The yen will remain sensitive to global risk sentiment.

articles.title: Imperial Japanese Army secretly considered martial law in 1945, document says
articles.summary: The considerations were made during the final stages of World War II amid concerns that U.S. air raids would severely disrupt public order.

articles.title: Asian Games put spotlight on cricket’s growth in Japan
articles.summary: The ongoing Games and a historic contest against India are giving cricket an opportunity to add to its steady growth.

articles.title: Typhoon Dujuan leaves at least nine dead and four missing near Tokyo
articles.summary: Chiba Prefecture reported six deaths while Kanagawa Prefecture reported three as of 8 a.m. Wednesday. Two people are missing in each prefecture.

articles.title: Takaichi holds first talks with Zelenskky, but no mention of defense cooperation
articles.summary: The Ukrainian leader did not publicly broach the possibility of tieups with Tokyo such as in the area of drone development and air defense equipment.

articles.title: More teen magic in Asian Games pool as Kojima thrills Japan
articles.summary: The 17-year-old Yumeki Kojima's triumph in the men's 400-meter individual medley set a Games record of 4 minutes, 7.02 seconds.

articles.title: Embraer nears regional jet order from Japan Airlines in blow to Airbus
articles.summary: The carrier, which has been weighing whether to order Embraer's E2 or Airbus's A220, is due to make a final decision as soon as October, sources said.

articles.title: Indonesia to develop earthquake early warning system with Japan’s help
articles.summary: Indonesia plans to conduct trial runs for the envisioned warning system in Jakarta and some other regions by 2030.

articles.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
articles.summary: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.

articles.title: Four dead after powerful Typhoon Dujuan lashes Japan
articles.summary: The storm pulled away from Japan after bringing heavy rains and strong winds to Tokyo and surrounding areas.
